**Check-in at Haneda Airport Terminal 2**

18:00 Arrive at the airport, do the tax refund before check-in (new system from 1 Nov 2026)
- Do not put tax-free items in checked luggage until customs has cleared them
- Scan your passport at a customs Tax Refund Kiosk (or use Visit Japan Web on the airport Wi-Fi, before security)
- Green = done / Red = take the items to the customs inspection point
- The refund is paid later by the shop or its refund provider (the way you chose when buying)
- Covers purchases of 5,000 yen or more (before tax) per shop per day, unused in Japan

22:25 Check in (counters usually open about 3 hrs before the flight)
- Have your passport ready

01:25 Flight departs (2 Dec), lands in Bangkok 06:30
